Moved

Methods was four pages’ worth of one page

Everything that was here is still on this site, on the page where the question it answers comes up. Nothing was dropped.

Where each part went

What a flag is
The {{n_flags_word}} a check can return, why Unknown is not a fourth degree of severity and a blank is a third thing again, and what a Pass does not say — on the checks page, with the checks it is a statement about.
The split these numbers are on
Why one split per dataset is quoted and why it is not a maximum over splits.
Reading a probe AUROC
What a probe fits, why the AUROC it reaches is a lower bound and never an upper one, and the figure of the strongest probe on each of the {{n_probed}} probed datasets.
Reading a split overlap
What the leakage scan compares, why both directions are reported, and the figure of where the {{n_leakage_scanned}} scanned datasets fall.
Reading a joint AUROC
The same features read together rather than one at a time, which is the fifth Core Set criterion and is described where it is applied.
How to cite this run
What identifies the run on screen, and what to cite until the manuscript has a DOI. Where the committed tables and the {{n_reports}} fetched reports come from, and which curated datasets were never measured, is in this repository’s README, whose reader is a maintainer.

The table of what each check returned was on this page and on the checks page, rendered from the same values. There is one of it now.
